in_hebrew.name: Gustavo
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Staff of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gustavo הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin name Gustavus, derived from the Old German word gust, meaning 'staff' or 'goose'. In the Middle Ages, the name was associated with the Roman god Toutatis, who was depicted carrying a staff. In Christianity, the name is sometimes associated with Saint Gustav of Prague, a bishop who resisted the Hussite Wars.
